entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand. Just need the authorization number.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Can I get your order number or the email associated with your account?
Order 987-555-1212. Let's get this done, I have another call in five minutes.

Understood. Pulling up 987-555-1212... I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker on December 15th. That was 21 days ago. To get started, can you tell me, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. It's not the point. I tried to return this on day 9, but your whole system was down. I kept getting a website error.
I see. So you attempted the return online, but because the system was down you couldn't print the return label?
Correct. I have a screenshot of the error page from December 24th. I assumed you knew your own site was broken.

I do apologize for that inconvenience. Let me just check our system logs for that date... Yes, I can confirm there was a known outage on the 24th that affected our returns portal. Thank you for bringing that to my attention. One moment while I review the policy for your item.
Just tell me yes or no.

Thank you for holding. Okay, I've checked our policy, and all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Fine. Send the label to my email.

Of course. I have just initiated the return. The email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions is on its way to you now. You should see it within a few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
